channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Offered Lift, Then Incapacitated: Woman Allegedly Raped After Birthday Party in Udaipur; IT Firm’s CEO Arrested, Probe On
item.description: A woman's casual invite to her CEO's birthday party in Udaipur spiralled into alleged gangrape by him and two colleagues, prompting swift arrests and outrage over workplace safety.

item.title: New Wings for India: Three Airlines Approved as Govt Moves to Break Aviation Duopoly After IndiGo Meltdown, All You Need to Know
item.description: India greenlights Shankh Air, Al Hind Air, and FlyExpress to boost competition following the massive IndiGo operational crisis.

item.title: Who Is 10-Year-Old Shravan Singh? Young Hero Honoured for Helping Soldiers During Operation Sindoor
item.description: President Murmu honoured young Shravan Singh for providing vital supplies to soldiers during intense border tensions.

item.title: Odisha’s Dr. K. Laxmi Bai, 100, Donates ₹3.4 Crores to AIIMS Bhubaneswar for Women’s Cancer Care
item.description: A 100-year-old retired gynaecologist donates ₹3.4 crore savings to AIIMS Bhubaneswar for underprivileged gynaecological cancer research, care.

item.title: India Claims top Spot in Global Bitcoin Holders, with China and Japan Trailing Behind
item.description: India leads global Bitcoin ownership with up to 119 million holders, fueled by youth adoption and digital savvy, even as taxes and warnings persist.

item.title: Breaking the Gender Gear: Himachal’s First Woman Truck Driver Neha Thakur Redefines India’s Highways
item.description: Neha Thakur, backed by her trucker father, defies gender norms to become Himachal's pioneering female truck driver and YouTuber, inspiring a wave of women in logistics.

item.title: UP Class 10 Student Allegedly Dies By Suicide Over Suspected AI-Assisted Cheating; Probe On
item.description: A 16-year-old girl in Greater Noida allegedly died by suicide after being accused of using AI tools to cheat in exams.

item.title: Protests Outside Jammu Lok Bhavan Over MBBS Admissions; Effigy of LG Manoj Sinha Burnt Amid Non-Local Bias Allegations
item.description: Dozens of locals protested outside Jammu's Lok Bhavan on December 27, burning an effigy of Lt Governor Manoj Sinha to demand cancellation of the allegedly irregular MBBS admission list at Reasi's Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Institute.

item.title: Australia Issues Warning Over Counterfeit Rabies Vaccine In India; Manufacturer Refutes Charges
item.description: Australia has warned travellers about fake rabies vaccines in India, while manufacturer IIL refutes the "over-cautionary" advisory.

item.title: From Age-Group Cricket To IPL Glory, Vaibhav Suryavanshi Wins Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar
item.description: Recognised by President Droupadi Murmu, Vaibhav Suryavanshi’s Bal Puraskar honour celebrates discipline, records and India’s growing faith in youth talent.
